name: Cynthia
source:
Cynthia is a master Pokémon trainer with a strong fascination with lore and mythology. Once a student at Kobukan Academy, she dropped out in order to pursue her own adventures. She occasionally visits the academy to spectate campus events or offer words of wisdom to the students.

Cynthia was first introduced in Pokémon Diamond and Pokémon Pearl versions.
